data.summary: Intuitive Surgical has established organizational capability for AI integration through a dedicated Head of Digital and AI Strategy role, but substantive AI-driven product innovations and business integration remain limited in available 10-K disclosures.
evidence: 10-K mentions 'Brian E. Miller, Ph.D., the Company's Head of Digital and AI Strategy' in Rule 10b5-1 Plans section
No detailed AI product features, algorithms, or revenue contributions described in provided 10-K extracts
Digital strategy appears focused on simulation, telepresence, and analytics (SimNow, Advanced Insights Suite, Case Insights, Insights Engine) rather than explicit AI/ML applications
_validation: Verified existence of 'Head of Digital and AI Strategy' role from 10-K Rule 10b5-1 Plans section
Updated stance from 'absent' to 'nascent' to reflect organizational AI capability despite limited product disclosure
Limited evidence in provided extracts; full 10-K may contain additional AI-related disclosures in product innovation or technology sections not included in excerpts provided
